sources.title: Cache Eviction Policy Analysis: LRU vs LFU vs ML - GitHub
sources.snippet: Figure 1. Hit rate vs. cache size for LRU, LFU, and ML eviction on the same Zipfian trace. LRU trails both other policies at every size — recency alone is a weak signal on a Zipf-distributed trace. LFU and ML are nearly tied throughout, and the gap between them narrows further as cache size grows ...
